spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): v2183 introduces a dedicated projection schema payment_method_details_payment_record_boleto with tax_id nullable:true and not in required (in v2182 the payment-record surfaces reuse the shared boleto schema whose tax_id is required). The shared payment_method_boleto and payment_method_details_boleto schemas keep tax_id required and non-nullable in both versions, so only payment_records / payment_attempt_records read surfaces are affected. Ten records are per-operation projections of this single schema change.

fix.migration_guide: payment_method_details.boleto.tax_id can now be null on GET /v1/payment_records/{id}. Guard reads of the field on payment_records and payment_attempt_records surfaces (optional chaining or an explicit null check) before using it as a document identifier. Charge-surface boleto objects are unaffected; only the payment-record projection relaxed the field.
